catalogue.name: BRCA1 / BRCA2 variant pathogenicity
catalogue.description: Every classified BRCA1 and BRCA2 variant in ClinVar, described by molecular features derived from the HGVS notation: consequence class, Grantham chemical distance, hydropathy and charge shifts, functional-domain membership and splice proximity.
catalogue.notes: Collapsed to one row per variant before splitting; 37,170 duplicate assembly rows removed. 15,581 unresolved variants held out for the VUS Resolver.

catalogue.name: Breast cancer — diagnostic imaging features
catalogue.description: Thirty morphological features — radius, texture, concavity and their worst-case statistics — computed from digitised images of fine-needle aspirates of a breast mass.
catalogue.notes: The canonical benchmark for quantum-kernel classification papers.

catalogue.name: Coronary artery disease
catalogue.source: UCI Heart Disease (Cleveland), Detrano et al.
catalogue.description: Thirteen routine clinical measurements — resting blood pressure, cholesterol, exercise-induced angina, ST depression and vessel counts — used to predict angiographic coronary disease.
catalogue.notes: Contains genuine missing values, which the imputation stage handles.

catalogue.name: Parkinson's disease — voice biomarkers
catalogue.description: Twenty-two acoustic measures of sustained phonation — jitter, shimmer, harmonic-to-noise ratio and nonlinear dynamical measures — recorded from 31 people, 23 with Parkinson's.
catalogue.notes: Small and high-dimensional: 195 recordings against 22 features, the low-data regime where quantum kernels are argued to help.

catalogue.name: Type 2 diabetes onset
catalogue.description: Eight routine measurements — plasma glucose, BMI, blood pressure, serum insulin and family history — recorded to predict diabetes onset within five years.
catalogue.notes: Zeros in glucose, blood pressure, skin fold, insulin and BMI are recording gaps rather than real values, so they are restored to missing before imputation.
